pkgmetadata.longdescription: cppzmq is the official header-only C++ binding for libzmq (ZeroMQ). It maps the libzmq C API to C++ concepts: type-safe handles instead of void*, exception-based error handling instead of errno, and RAII classes that release contexts, sockets and messages automatically. Only two headers are installed, zmq.hpp (direct mappings of the C API) and zmq_addon.hpp (higher-level helpers such as multipart messages), together with a pkg-config file and the CMake package files that make find_package(cppzmq) work. Because it is header-only nothing is compiled here: the code becomes part of whatever links against libzmq.
